name: aicourse-top
description: aicourse.top — a free, open course in agentic engineering for people new to software engineering: an illustrated handbook, a browser lab and a TypeScript course, in nine languages.

scripts.build: npm run secrets:check && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run handbook:check && npm run widgets:check && npm run i18n:check:keys && npm run progress:check && npm run course-capabilities:check && npm run course-platform:check && next build && npm run course-static-export:check && npm run agent-orchestration:static-check && npm run mcp:audit:export
scripts.test:smoke: npm run evidence:prepare && npm run test:smoke:safe && npm run test:smoke:private
scripts.test:compat: npm run evidence:prepare && npm run test:compat:safe
scripts.test:resilience: npm run evidence:prepare && npm run test:resilience:safe
scripts.build:release: npm run agentic-video-editing:check:release && npm run build && npm run i18n:check:release && npm run test:course-kit:export && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:compat && npm run test:resilience && npm run test:evidence-contract && npm run artifacts:check && npm run release:check && npm run course-platform:check:release
scripts.codex:release: npm run codex:check:release && next build && npm run codex:audit:export && npm run test:codex:export && npm run codex:lint-baseline
scripts.mcp:release: npm run mcp:check:release && next build && npm run test:mcp:export
scripts.agent-orchestration:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-agent-orchestration-course.mjs --release && npm run agent-orchestration:i18n-check && npm run agent-orchestration:progress-check && npm run agent-orchestration:lab-check
scripts.agentic-video-editing:release: npm run agentic-video-editing:check:release && npm run build && npm run agentic-video-editing:static-check && npm run test:agentic-video-editing
scripts.responsible-ai:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course responsible-ai && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course responsible-ai
scripts.ai-research:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course ai-research && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course ai-research
scripts.ai-python-data:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course ai-python-data && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course ai-python-data
scripts.machine-learning:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course machine-learning && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course machine-learning
scripts.deep-learning:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course deep-learning && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course deep-learning
scripts.production-ai:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs --course production-ai && node scripts/check-course-labs.mjs --course production-ai
scripts.course-kit:check:release: node --import tsx scripts/check-course-kit-release.mjs && npm run course-labs:check:release
scripts.test:grok: COURSE_TEST_ID=grok COURSE_TEST_PORT=3120 playwright test tests/grok-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:prompts: COURSE_TEST_ID=prompts COURSE_TEST_PORT=3121 playwright test tests/prompts-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:github: COURSE_TEST_ID=github COURSE_TEST_PORT=3122 playwright test tests/github-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:software-engineering: COURSE_TEST_ID=software-engineering COURSE_TEST_PORT=3123 playwright test tests/software-engineering-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:rag: COURSE_TEST_ID=rag COURSE_TEST_PORT=3124 playwright test tests/rag-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:claude-income: COURSE_TEST_ID=claude-income COURSE_TEST_PORT=3125 playwright test tests/claude-income-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:ai-tutor: COURSE_TEST_ID=ai-tutor COURSE_TEST_PORT=3126 playwright test tests/ai-tutor-course.spec.ts --config tests/course-playwright.config.ts
